note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (8×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: SoftBank suffers worst day in over two years as AI sell-off hits Asian tech stocks
items.blurb: SoftBank, a major OpenAI backer, fell about 14% as investors questioned returns on heavy AI infrastructure spending.

items.title: Anthropic shares fall 6% in premarket amid AI selloff as Nvidia, AMD shares drop
items.blurb: A day after its record debut, Anthropic stock slipped with chipmakers as the broader AI trade stayed under pressure.

items.title: Anthropic IPO 'exactly what the markets need,' but analysts warn of volatility
items.blurb: Analysts see the listing as a test of public appetite for AI labs, but expect sharp swings in early trading.

items.title: AI is changing software engineering — and some developers miss the struggle
items.blurb: Most developers now use AI coding tools, and some say faster output has cost the job part of its satisfaction.

items.title: Anthropic raises $93.5 billion total as underwriters scoop up 'greenshoe' overallotment
items.blurb: Underwriters bought 147 million extra shares at $83, lifting the record IPO's total to $93.5 billion.

items.title: Tech wreck drags Anthropic into the red on its second day of trading
items.blurb: A broad tech sell-off erased part of Anthropic's 17% first-day gain before Friday's open.

items.title: Anthropic defies the odds, holding record IPO despite 'massively disruptive' market
items.blurb: Anthropic went ahead with the largest IPO on record while AI chip stocks were falling sharply.

items.title: "This is a painful tech sell-off": Anthropic shares slump
items.blurb: Analysts tie Anthropic's second-day drop to a broad tech sell-off rather than anything specific to the company.

items.title: Banks feast on ANT offering
items.blurb: Underwriters stand to earn large fees from the biggest IPO on record, Anthropic's Nasdaq listing.

items.title: Stocks making the biggest moves Friday: Anthropic, Ross Stores, Gap & more
items.blurb: Anthropic led Friday's notable movers as AI-linked shares extended their slide.

items.title: The most misunderstood graph in AI just got a major update
items.blurb: METR's chart of how long a task AI can finish shows fast gains, with weaker results on tasks that need judgment.

items.title: Nvidia stock plunges 14%, wraps up longest weekly losing streak since 2008 financial crisis
items.blurb: Nvidia has fallen seven straight weeks, losing about $2.6 trillion in value as investors question the AI buildout.

items.title: Nvidia shares plunge as Anthropic can't stop the AI selloff
items.blurb: Anthropic's record listing failed to steady chip stocks, as Nvidia and AMD both fell sharply on Friday.

items.title: Why Anthropic's day-one valuation wasn't built to last in this market
items.blurb: Analysts argue Anthropic's first-day valuation outran a market already souring on AI spending.

items.title: Mathematician says he and AI solved Riemann hypothesis — the field's biggest outstanding challenge
items.blurb: An Anthropic mathematician claims a Claude-assisted proof of math's top open problem; number theorists say the sketch needs rigorous checking.

items.title: SpaceX's subsidiary Cursor tells lawmakers it's considering phasing out Chinese AI models
items.blurb: A House report says the coding-tool maker may drop Chinese open-weight models over geopolitical risk.

items.title: Senate passes BAAJA permitting reform bill backed by AI, energy sectors
items.blurb: The Senate voted 62-33 to speed permits for energy projects that AI data centers need; the House must still act.

items.title: AI boom's wealth surge could cut both ways for economy
items.blurb: Stock gains from AI have lifted household wealth and spending, which a sustained sell-off could reverse.

items.title: Anthropic IPO live updates: Dario and Daniela Amodei arrive at Nasdaq ahead of debut
items.blurb: Anthropic begins trading as ANT after selling 980 million shares at $83, the largest IPO on record.

items.title: Anthropic lifts Nasdaq futures and tech stocks ahead of its record-breaking IPO
items.blurb: Chipmakers and Anthropic's investors rose before the bell as markets awaited the debut.

items.title: Anthropic is ready for its IPO. Three analysts see huge gains for the stock
items.blurb: Wolfe Research and Melius set price targets well above the $83 offering price.

items.title: AI is ditching hallucinated references — and other bad habits

items.title: Claude crushes it on Wall Street
items.blurb: Anthropic raised about $81 billion selling 980 million shares, testing public appetite for frontier AI labs.

items.title: Exclusive: JPMorgan, GM, Pfizer want bigger say in AI policy
items.blurb: Big companies that use AI, not build it, formed a council to push for a seat in safety rulemaking.
